verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for an analytics product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no opt-out mechanism, whether for the product's own telemetry or for tracked end users. The User Deletion API and data-retention settings are adjacent controls: they delete or retain data rather than opt out of collection, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
